disposition_reason: Dietary manganese intake estimates from three-day records for 257 Korean children; Korean adequate intake and upper level values stated; no measured concentrations.

study.method: three-day dietary record; CAN-Pro 3.0; Korean food manganese database

unresolved: Intake may be overestimated because energy intake exceeded national survey values (Discussion).
regulatory_or_exposure: Korean adequate intake ages 12-14: 4.0 mg/day boys, 3.5 mg/day girls; tolerable upper intake level 7.0 mg/day (pp. 548-549)
Mean intake 4295.4 ug/day overall, 117.3% of adequate intake; no child above upper level (Table 2)
Cereals 50.8%, vegetables 21.0%, seasonings 8.9%, pulses 7.7% of intake; milled rice 39.8% (Tables 3 and 4)
